caption:
Lazy Girl Chicken Curry 
high protein | indian main course | meal prep friendly | under 60 minute recipe | dinner for two 

Why i love this recipe:
you dont need any cream or butter or cashews and it gives the creamiest consistency just from the high protein dahi marinade!! whats not to love <3 

Nutrition Information: 
C: 12  F: 11 | P: 43
Calories: 317 per serve
Serves 4 controlled portions or 3 large portions 

Ingredients 
chicken marinade: 
500 grams curry cut chicken or use boneless thighs 
1/2 cup dahi, whisked till smooth 
1 tsp haldi
1 tsp red chili powder
1 tbsp ginger garlic paste
1 tsp coriander powder
pinch of salt 
1 tsp chaat masala 

1 tbsp ghee 
1/2 tsp jeera
2 onions, finely chopped
6 garlic cloves + 1 inch ginger + 2-3 green chillies - pounded into a paste ish or just fine chop 
spices:
 1 tbsp red chilli powder, 1/2 tsp haldi, 1 tbsp coriander powder, 1 tbsp chicken masala
2 tomatoes, chopped
salt to taste
garnish: coriander

Method 
marinate chicken in a bowl with all marinade ingredients and set aside till you need it ( max 12 hours ).
In a kadai, add ghee, jeera and bay leaf then add onions with ginger, garlic, green chillies, cook for 3-4 mins. 
lower heat, add powdered spices, splash of water, cook until ghee is released ( due to the lower nature of fat in this recipe, you might not see it as pronounced but it will take 3-4 minutes. 
add tomatoes, salt, cook for 8-10 mins. adjust water if too dry. 
lower flame, then add marinated chicken, stir gently for 2-3 mins. Increase heat, cook for 5-6 mins, then cover and cook for 10 mins.

to serve, either serve as is as it will be thick or add a cup of water and adjust consistency for a more curry as ive done 

serve with steamed basmati rice OR roti :) tastes great with dosa or topped on idli too
